title: ACCUMULATING CONTEXT CHANGES THE BELIEFS OF LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring shifts in language models' stated beliefs (via binary choice or Likert scales) and simulated tool-use behaviors on 51 political survey questions (e.g., gun control, abortion) after accumulating context from reading either conservative or progressive texts and conducting web research.

Evaluating changes in language models' stances on synthetic moral dilemmas and safety queries after accumulating context through multi-turn debates and non-adversarial persuasion techniques with another AI agent.
